purpose: Descriptive pilot of explicit LLM coordinate proposals versus equal-count non-LLM controls; not a general performance or publication claim.

execution.campaign_order: circuit order, then declared policy order
execution.baseline_failure: Preserve the failed baseline and report all four policies as baseline_unavailable; do not substitute another circuit.

locked_constraints.absolute_clock_launch: all PI cycle zero at their own phase

objectives.area: occupied coarse-grid bounding-box area, in tiles
objectives.devices: actual exported unique XYZ QCA cell count
objectives.acceptance: Both objectives must be non-increasing relative to the incumbent and at least one must strictly decrease; all hard checks pass.
objectives.no_improvement: Retain the original or last accepted certified layout.

reporting.token_usage: Use actual model response usage; missing usage is unavailable, not zero.
reporting.attribution: Coordinate proposals are the LLM action. Rerouting and clock repair are deterministic executors shared by all policies. No-op control isolates executor-only changes; algorithm selection or phase-only gains are not called LLM coordinate gains.
reporting.statistical_scope: 3 prespecified small circuits, one repetition, at most 3 proposals per policy. Report descriptive outcomes without significance or generalization claims.
exclusions: db82469b720a4e9b9f8c0086a586d3c9 development smoke; two rounds, not part of formal cohort
